WHERE NOTICE_STATUS = 'Y'
AND NOTICE_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND TYPE_NAME = #{typeName}
AND START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND START_DATE > DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)
AND (START_DATE IS NULL OR START_DATE <= DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) AND (END_DATE IS NULL OR END_DATE >= DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
AND END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND END_DATE < DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)
mapper.select:
SELECT NOTICE_NO, USER_NO, NOTICE_TITLE, NOTICE_CONTENT, NOTICE_MODIFIEDDATE, START_DATE, END_DATE, NOTICE_STATUS, NOTICE_DELETE, TYPE_NAME, CASE WHEN START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND START_DATE > DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR) THEN '진행전' WHEN END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND END_DATE < DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR) THEN '종료' ELSE '진행중' END AS PROGRESS_STATUS FROM NOTICE
ORDER BY NOTICE_MODIFIEDDATE DESC, NOTICE_NO DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
